clue.text: Sneak to bring the game to an end?

definitions.meaning: to sneak is to tell tales, informing on wrongdoing to someone in authority

definitions.text: bring the game to an end?
definitions.meaning: a referee sounds a blast at the close of a match

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the literal second reading, a referee signalling full time.
explanation.definitionFit: Exposing wrongdoing is informing, like a sneak, and a referee's final blast literally ends a football match.

clue.text: Reveal the Parisian fashion

parts.note: le is French for 'the', as said in Paris
ton is an old word for fashion or style

explanation.surface: Someone unveils the latest Paris fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: To divulge a secret is to reveal it.

clue.text: Cheerless test after earlier victory

indicators.note: after says the test word follows the victory word

parts.note: a win is a victory, placed first because it is earlier
a try is a test or attempt

explanation.surface: A gloomy exam taken after an earlier triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: Bleak, cold weather is dreary, so a cheerless manner can be called frosty and wintry.

clue.text: Storms and commotions around half of Canada

indicators.note: around says the commotion word wraps the piece of Canada

parts.note: hurries are commotions or bustles

indicators.note: half of means only the first three of the six letters of Canada are used

explanation.surface: Gales and upheavals sweeping across part of Canada.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurricanes are violent tropical storms.

clue.text: Decline, being pale and sick with little energy

parts.note: wan means pale and sickly-looking
E is the abbreviation for energy, a little of the word

explanation.surface: An invalid fading away, pallid and short of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: To dwindle or diminish is to decline, as the moon does after full.

clue.text: Put in office in street that has everything

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: Someone installed in an office in a street that offers every amenity.
explanation.definitionFit: To instate someone formally in a post is to induct them.

clue.text: A Stalin involved in the heartless torment

indicators.note: in says the tangled letters go inside the other word
heartless means the word the loses its middle letter
involved means the letters of A Stalin are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Stalin caught up in heartless cruelty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' turns A STALIN into ANTALIS, which goes 'in' TE, the word 'the' made 'heartless' by losing its H.
explanation.definitionFit: To tease by offering something then withholding it is a torment.

clue.text: Formal garments obtainable from seven designers

indicators.note: obtainable from suggests the letters of seven designers can be reworked to yield the phrase

explanation.surface: Smart gowns available from seven couturiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Long gowns worn for a formal night occasion are formal garments.

clue.text: Deirdre holds an awkward hen

indicators.note: awkward signals that the letters of Deirdre holds an are clumsily jumbled

explanation.surface: A woman named Deirdre clumsily clutches a chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holds' looks like a container signal but it is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a breed of chicken, so the bird is an example of a hen.

clue.text: Two things a batsman can do to create an accident

definitions.text: Two things a batsman can do
definitions.meaning: a cricket batsman can strike the ball and then score by running
a road crash in which the driver flees the scene

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batsman strikes the ball and then runs between the wickets to score.
explanation.definitionFit: Striking and running are two batting actions; a crash where the driver drives off is a hit-and-run.

clue.text: Char is slightly deficient vocalist

indicators.note: slightly deficient means a little is missing, here the final letter of the vocalist word

parts.note: a singer is a vocalist

explanation.surface: Someone says a cleaning lady is a rather poor vocalist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Char' looks like a British cleaning lady (charwoman), but it is the verb to scorch.
explanation.definitionFit: To scorch or burn lightly on the surface is to char.

clue.text: One country chap turned over old coins

indicators.note: turned over means the whole run of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
Iran is a country
Ed is a man's name, a chap

explanation.surface: A rural fellow overturned a stash of ancient money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' reverses I + IRAN + ED, IIRANED, as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: These were silver coins of ancient Rome, so they are old currency.

clue.text: Expedition not completely free from danger, endlessly lacking water

indicators.note: not completely means the safety word loses its final letter

parts.note: safe means free from danger

indicators.note: endlessly means the dry word loses its last letter

parts.note: arid means lacking water, parched

explanation.surface: A trek that is not entirely safe, forever short of water.
explanation.definitionFit: A journey to observe or hunt wild animals, especially in Africa, is an expedition.

clue.text: Bird about to wail trapped under loose rock

indicators.note: trapped under says, in this down clue, the about and wail pieces sit beneath the rock word

parts.note: scree is loose broken rock on a mountain slope
C is short for circa, Latin for about
to howl is to wail

explanation.surface: A creature wails, pinned beneath fallen stones.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an American species of small owl, so a bird.

clue.text: Two lovers with sex appeal taking me aback

parts.note: it is old slang for sex appeal

indicators.note: aback means the word me is taken backwards

explanation.surface: An alluring couple turns to look back at me.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple in a romantic relationship is called an item in everyday speech.

clue.text: Digs made by former lover Eva, cast adrift

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: adrift means the letters of Eva cast float loose into a new order

explanation.surface: Lodgings found by an old flame, Eva, set adrift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Digs' looks like British slang for lodgings, but it is the verb. 'adrift' scrambles EVA CAST into CAVATES.
explanation.definitionFit: To unearth by removing soil is to dig out a site.

clue.text: Getting rid of corporal punishment when holding group of terrorists

indicators.note: holding says the punishment word contains the terrorist unit

parts.note: caning is beating with a cane, a corporal punishment
a cell is a small group of terrorists or spies

explanation.surface: Abolishing beatings for a gang of terrorists who are being held.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling off or scrapping something is removing it.

clue.text: Worker by canal who has a little case with the loved one's hair?

definitions.meaning: someone who works the gates where boats change level on a canal

definitions.text: who has a little case with the loved one's hair?
definitions.meaning: a person keeping a curl of a sweetheart's hair, as in a locket

explanation.definitionFit: A canal attendant operates the gates; humorously, the phrase also describes a person who treasures a tress of hair.

clue.text: One lights a fire — what could be more agreeable when drinking litre?

indicators.note: drinking says the agreeable word swallows the litre abbreviation

parts.note: kinder means more agreeable or pleasant

explanation.surface: Asking what could be nicer than sipping a litre by a fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something that sets a fire going ignites it.

clue.text: Alarm female listener

parts.note: the ear is the organ of hearing, a listener

explanation.surface: Someone startles a woman who is listening.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarm is a feeling of sudden dread.

clue.text: Work with great effort to get a new catchphrase

parts.note: to slog is to work hard and laboriously

explanation.surface: Toiling hard to come up with fresh advertising words.
explanation.definitionFit: A memorable motto used in advertising or politics is a catchphrase.

clue.text: Number wanting nave transformed for days of prayer

indicators.note: transformed means the letters of nave are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A church whose nave is remodelled for a period of devotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A Catholic devotion of prayers said over nine consecutive days.

clue.text: We can hear funny man Peter in the rooms below

indicators.note: we can hear signals the comedian's surname is what is spoken, not written

parts.note: Peter Sellers was a British comic actor

explanation.surface: We listen to a comedian performing in a basement.
explanation.walkthrough: Peter Sellers was the comic actor of the Goon Show and the Pink Panther films.
explanation.definitionFit: Basements are rooms underground, below a house.

clue.text: Farewell notice is full of love

parts.note: an ad is an advertisement, a notice

indicators.note: full of says the word is contains the love letter

parts.note: O stands for love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: A notice brimming with affection says goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: Spanish for goodbye, used in English as a farewell.

clue.text: Fish dishonourable man hauled up on end of line

indicators.note: hauled up means, in this down clue, the scoundrel word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a cad is a dishonourable man

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of line

explanation.surface: A scoundrel landing a catch at the end of his fishing line.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a small freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: One animal and another only a quarter the length of elephant

parts.note: another animal, here a rat

indicators.text: only a quarter the length of
indicators.note: only a quarter the length of means two of the eight letters of elephant, taken from the front

explanation.surface: Comparing two creatures, one just a quarter of an elephant's size.
explanation.walkthrough: The animal is the honey badger, found in Africa and Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the honey badger, so one example of an animal.

clue.text: A hypotenuse close by

parts.note: the hypotenuse is the longest edge of a right-angled triangle, a long side

explanation.surface: A triangle's slanting edge lies near at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Next to or beside means close by.

clue.text: Confusion may be brought about by one's riddles, sir

indicators.note: brought about suggests the letters are turned around and reassembled

parts.note: the possessive here keeps its S as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: Bewilderment caused by someone's puzzles, sir.
explanation.definitionFit: Untidiness and disarray amount to confusion.
